prompt:
Draw exactly ONE NEW COMPLETE full-body animation frame of classic GOMORA, the brown Ancient Monster in Ultraman 1966. Keep his complete intact long tail and intact short nasal horn from the accepted runtime master. NOT EX Gomora, not a later summoned version, not the second-battle severed-tail state. The TWO attached images are IDENTITY ONLY: accepted complete native pixel master, and its clean complete original source uniformly aspect-fitted. Neither attached pose is the requested action. Fixed SIDE-VIEW arcade fighting camera; facing RIGHT. No camera rotation, zoom, foreshortened front view or added perspective. Draw ONE coherent whole monster: head, TWO connected arms and shoulders, continuous chest and pelvis, BOTH distinct weight-bearing legs, and exactly ONE thick long tapering tail from pelvis to ONE complete tip. The two crescent head horns, blunt face, short nasal horn, small amber eye, earthy brown/tan scaled suit hide, ribbed belly and dorsal scale plates must match the accepted master. Preserve skull, torso, thigh, shin, feet and tail anatomical proportions even when bent; never shrink the monster to fit its pose. NEAR limbs are lighter brown; FAR entire arm, leg and ear horn are naturally darker from generation, with coherent one-pixel dark overlap edges. No later masked recoloring. Complete connected natural suit surfaces: NO toy ball joints, pivot discs, peg holes, straight open waist seam, screws, stand, part sockets or plastic gloss. Keep actual monster scales and skin folds. Native fighting-game PIXEL finish with deliberate hard pixel clusters, restrained brown palette, thin dark pixel contour and upper-left light. Transparent 1024x1024 PNG, 真正PNG Alpha透明，透明背景. At least 40 transparent output pixels around every horn, claw, sole and tail tip. Invisible staging only: grounded supporting soles near y=930, hips around x=560; complete rear tail extends LEFT with a natural arc. Reserve generous empty room above the back and behind the body. Keep master anatomical scale corresponding to an approximately 680–720 output-pixel upright body as an initial composition target, not a per-frame bbox fit. The actual common source-to-native scale will be chosen after the first returned frame is measured. Draw the monster ALONE. Do not draw, bake, outline or silhouette an opponent, burden, dummy or object on the back; a separate complete runtime opponent will be positioned only after real physical capture. No ground, shadow, scenery, text, grid, effect, aura, beam, dust, speed line or motion ghost. Do not paste, rotate, cut or assemble limbs. Do not copy any prior half-circle grab, palm kick, tail sweep, uppercut, burrowing charge, old wave or EX pose. Independently paint this absolute whole-body pose, with both arms, shoulders, chest, hips, knees, ankles and tail cooperating.
NEW INDEPENDENT PHASE 10 of 18 — FINAL HIP EXTENSION BEFORE RELEASE. Both broad feet stay planted, knees almost straight but naturally soft, hips centered and chest near vertical with only a slight ten-degree forward inclination. Back and shoulders lift together, head and intact nasal horn face RIGHT and slightly up, no extreme neck bend. NEAR light claw opens forward at chest level, elbow still bent; FAR dark arm opens farther out at waist/rib height, both shoulders connected. Hands are ceasing support, not gripping an invisible neck. The single complete tail gently dips LEFT/back for balance. This is still the lift-end before the fully opened release; no beam, palm hit or jump. SUPPORT-FOOT ORDER: as observed in accepted phase07, the NEAR lighter thigh/leg/foot is on the rear LEFT and the FAR darker thigh/leg/foot is on the front RIGHT. Both complete broad feet remain planted in this support order; do not exchange them between phases or use foot sliding instead of knee/hip action. This is an anatomy/continuity instruction only, not an extra image attachment.
